what: Hidden-layer series work and the sibling layer toggle at the map's opening view (z9, Florida east coast; 844 x 390 dpr 2), offline (frontend/scripts/offline-backend/scn_sibling_toggle.js), one fresh browser per row. Builds: A = claude/sibling-prewarm-idle at a94991ef0 (dev 58b55f8f1 merged in, so #488 is in): no static source covers a z9 box, today's live case. B = A + the regional-bundles client branch at its committed head 701e88bba, merged locally and never pushed: a regional bundle covers z9 Florida for all four GFS layers (published from the same store with dev's publisher). A_pre488 = the branch at 76391512f, before dev (with #488's mask-paint fix) was merged in and before the series trigger existed. Arms: cur (this PR); before (__RAW_DISABLE_SIBLING_IDLE_PAGES__ + __RAW_DISABLE_SIBLING_WARM_ON_SERIES__; in A_pre488 only the first, the second did not exist); noregional (__RAW_DISABLE_REGIONAL_BUNDLES__). hiddenFrameReadyMs: when each hidden layer's toggle frame could be cached (cur: its mini's end; before: its page's end), ms after the Waves click.
box_model: The synthetic backend answers at once, so every weather ask went through a 1-CPU processor-sharing model (48-frame page 4000 ms of CPU pro rata, 1-hour mini 300 ms, /grid 400 ms; N asks in flight each get 1/N). The TIMES are modelled; the requests, their kinds and their order are the app's own.
surf_replay: The lead's 19:44Z pattern (Render logs: surf ON, ICON, z7-9 Florida, every small pan a new surf page; hidden-layer ICON surf minis and pages at 19:54 while the box sat at 100%), replayed offline on build A at c4f68d5eb (the surf gate in) over a GFS+ICON store: ZOOM 8 at (-79.95, 26.5), surf mode, the ICON chip, 'load' (no input, 120 s) and 'pans@20' (a drift of 30-120 px pans 1.2 s apart). Surf asks cost the box model 15 s per 16-frame page (pro rata), 1 s per mini, 1 s per /grid. Arms: cur; dev = the three new kill switches (surf gate, idle pages, series trigger) = today's dev sibling warm.
